name: Grimtotem Satchel
summary: Deep beneath Orgrimmar, Grimtotem Satchel stays in Maur Grimtotem’s grasp. Troggs killed the tauren in Ragefire Chasm, but he shielded the pouch as he died. Its return to Thunder Bluff draws Magatha Grimtotem’s attention.

sections.title: A Dying Grip
sections.body: Troggs killed Maur Grimtotem deep inside Ragefire Chasm, beneath Orgrimmar. When his body was found, the tauren still clutched a simple leather pack. He had fought to guard it as the troggs closed around him. What could it hold that made him defend it with his life?

sections.title: The Elder Crone's Interest
sections.body: Rahauro on the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff accepts the satchel for Magatha Grimtotem, matriarch of the Grimtotem clan. Maur served Magatha, and word reached her that he found something peculiar in the caverns beneath Orgrimmar before he died. She arranged a reward for the pack’s safe return. Magatha has a clear interest in what Maur found.

faq.q: Where is the Grimtotem Satchel found?
faq.answer: The Grimtotem Satchel was found beneath Maur Grimtotem’s body, deep inside Ragefire Chasm, the volcanic cavern beneath Orgrimmar. His arms still held it when troggs killed him.

faq.q: Who does the satchel belong to?
faq.answer: The satchel belonged to Maur Grimtotem, a member of the Grimtotem clan who entered Ragefire Chasm. He held it close as troggs attacked.
Rahauro on the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff accepts the satchel for Magatha Grimtotem. Magatha arranged a reward for the return of her fallen clansman’s belongings.

faq.q: Why was a Grimtotem carrying this under Orgrimmar?
aliases: what was the grimtotem doing in orgrimmar
faq.answer: Maur Grimtotem served Magatha Grimtotem, who took an interest in Ragefire Chasm. He went there to speak with the troggs and found something peculiar, but died before he could show it to her.
When Rahauro receives the pouch in Thunder Bluff, its contents remain sealed. Magatha hopes it holds signs of the peculiar thing Maur found in the chasm.

angles.text: A Grimtotem went deep beneath Orgrimmar, and word of what he found reached Magatha on the Elder Rise. The clan’s moves within the united tauren tribes are quiet and uneasy.
A dead Grimtotem courier lay deep in the tunnels beneath Thrall’s capital. Ragefire Chasm holds dangers beyond its beasts.
